title: Spain Pledges €437M in Military Aid to Ukraine Following Talks in Madrid
summary: President Volodymyr Zelensky announced that Spain will provide Ukraine with a new €437 million ($500 million) military aid package, following a meeting with Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez on the sidelines of the 30th Ibero-American Summit in Madrid on Thursday, Nov. 5. Zelensky, attending the summit for the first time, called for clear written security guarantees ahead of trilateral talks in Abu Dhabi on Nov. 10-11.
